prototypes.name: Questionnaire / Recommendation page
prototypes.description: The Every product quiz: intro, questions, reinforcement steps, loader and personalised results.

prototypes.name: Hello World
prototypes.description: A playful animated Hello World page.

prototypes.name: Bundle component exploration
prototypes.description: Explorations of the product page's bundle component for Perfect Portions: hero, box picker, meal cards and meal modal.

prototypes.name: Account Discover
prototypes.description: Redesign v2 of the Every Account Discover page.

versions.title: Responsive intro, new motion and meal modal
versions.changes: Added a 1024px breakpoint: intro goes image-left/copy-right, question and reinforcement steps sit in a 544px column. Rebuilt step animations (x-axis blur, cross-over exit, softer easing), press scale on options, and progress that counts reinforcement steps. Loader now hands over to results automatically. Satisfaction step has a Continue button and a neutral default face. New goal, household and eater icons, copy updates, and the meal modal rebuilt to match the website's MealDetailModal (no reviews).

versions.title: Controls in the studio
versions.changes: Added studio.json so the studio can drive the quiz from its controls: start point (homepage, quiz, loader, results), results page A or B, bundle, and challenge. No change to the quiz itself.

versions.title: First pass
versions.changes: Bouncing 'Hello World' lettering with a pulsing heart on a pink-to-blue gradient. Animations are disabled for reduced-motion users.

versions.title: Version 22 build
versions.changes: Pushed from the every-quiz-v22 working folder (fresh static export). Notes on what changed from v3.0 weren't written at the time.

versions.title: Rebuilt on team conventions (v23)
versions.changes: v21 refactored from plain HTML/JS into the team's Next.js conventions (Tailwind, ABC Diatype/Marist, one component per file, TODO(lift) markers). Replaces v3.1, which was a broken build. Includes the studio controls (start, variant, bundle, challenge).

versions.title: Latest build of quiz
versions.changes: Pushed the current static build of the quiz (homepage, quiz, loader, results A/B) as v3.3.

versions.title: Quiz flow map
versions.changes: Added a flow of every quiz step (homepage, ten quiz steps, loader, results A and B) so the studio can draw it. Added a ?step= link parameter (with start=quiz) so each step opens directly with sample answers filled in.

versions.title: Visual edits
versions.changes: Edited in the studio: 1 line of copy.

versions.title: Perfect Portions PDP: baseline and five variants
versions.changes: First version of the top of the Perfect Portions product page: header, hero, bundle box picker with price card, meals section and meal modal, built front end only with live Storyblok meals. Variant switcher in the studio covers five takes on the meals section: subhead sentence, tick chips, shelves by product type, circle recipe cards with tighter padding, and a featured one-at-a-time carousel with key ingredients. Variants 4 and 5 also override some meal photos and shorten the meal descriptions.

versions.title: Fix images on the studio
versions.changes: The logo, hero photo and replacement dish photos used absolute paths, so they 404ed under the studio's sub-path. They are now relative, and the meal modal resolves its photo before the URL changes. Nothing else changed.

versions.title: Swipe, dock and teaser for meal modal
versions.changes: Added v6 (v4 with swipe between meals in the meal modal, story-style progress and a first-open 'swipe to explore' hint), v7 (floating thumbnail dock to jump between meals) and v8 (floating 'Up next' teaser). Ticks chips on v2-v4 now use the bundle purple at 25% opacity. Removed the grabber bar from the meal modal.

versions.title: Fix v7 dock scrolling the page
versions.changes: The v7 thumbnail dock used scrollIntoView, which also scrolled the surrounding page when embedded. It now scrolls only its own strip.

versions.title: Fix page shift when menu modal opens
versions.changes: Opening 'See the full menu' removed the page scrollbar and shifted the content sideways. The shared scroll-lock hook now keeps the scrollbar's width as padding, as the meal detail modal already did.

versions.title: New v4, renumbered variants, v1 tiles
versions.changes: Added a new v4 (circle cards using the story's own recipe photos) and shifted the old v4-v8 to v5-v9. v1 now has v6's outlined nutrition tiles under the subhead and none below the menu button. Subheads on v1 and v6 use 16px body text and new copy (100% plant based, low sugar, no artificial additives, ~500 calories). More space (48px) above the meals headline on mobile in every variant.

versions.title: v4 as a 2x3 grid
versions.changes: v4 now shows only the first six meals in a static 2-column, 3-row grid instead of the carousel, with new card photos for the beetroot salad and ratatouille. Ratatouille is 7th in the box order, so its photo is not visible yet.

versions.title: New v4 card photos
versions.changes: v4 (2x3 grid of the first six meals) now uses new card photos for bami goreng, butter chicken, bolognese, chili sin carne, dal delight and the beetroot salad. Ratatouille's photo is uploaded but that meal is 7th in the box, so it does not show.

versions.title: Imported designer prototype
versions.changes: First upload of another designer's Discover redesign v2 HTML prototype, pushed as-is to see how the studio handles it.

versions.title: Curated meal modal tags (v10)
versions.changes: Added variant 10 (?v=10): the meal modal shows a curated tag set instead of every filter value. Vegan first, No Soy/Gluten/Garlic/Onion exclusions, merged fibre tag, one protein and one sugar tag, heat only when Medium or Very spicy. Other Without, fat and calorie tags are hidden in the modal only.

versions.title: Variant 10 in the picker
versions.changes: Added variant 10 (curated meal modal tags) to the studio's Variant control; v0.9 had the code but no way to select it.

versions.title: Assets linked into subfolders
versions.changes: Moved the redesign's image, icon, illustration and font references to point into the organised account-discover-assets subfolders so everything loads. Meals.png now uses featured-classic-reset-bowl-Meals.png.

versions.title: Variant 4 joined grid and menu modal
versions.changes: Variant 4: meal cards joined into one bordered grid (no gaps, #eee strokes, 18px clipped frame) with the last row cut in half and faded as a preview, the menu button then the nutrition tiles below. New Perfect Portions Menu modal with a 12/16/20 iOS-style switcher; tapping a recipe pushes it in as a page inside the modal with a back animation, scroll position kept, and recipe data fetched once and prefetched.

versions.title: Helena's copy updates
versions.changes: Applied Helena's copy edits from the Notion content guide: intro, question wording and answer options, loader lines, results hero headline, protein subhead and headline, and the Variant B challenge headings and cards. Left unclear or tbd items unchanged; results answer chips kept as they were.

versions.title: Gut health goal option
versions.changes: Added "Improve my gut health" as a fifth option on the goal question. It reuses the balanced-diet icon for now and routes to The Back to Better Bundle, since gut health has no bundle of its own yet.

versions.title: One flow: full menu and recipe modal
versions.changes: Down to a single flow (the story-photo grid with the Perfect Portions Menu modal); the other variants are gone. Menu modal: floating meal-count selector, sticky close button, scrolling heading with subhead, recipes push in with swipe between them and a fading back arrow. Recipe modal rebuilt to the Figma: review tag by the title, one-row nutrition bar, framed tags in the new ordered tag logic, open Ingredients with key ingredient tiles, animated accordions. Both modals animate out.

versions.title: Ingredient photos and key ingredients fix
versions.changes: Key ingredient tiles now use each ingredient's own photo, matched by name (500px WebP, 17.8MB down to 1.6MB). Fixed recipes that store key ingredients as bold name plus text, which showed none (e.g. crunchy beetroot salad).

versions.title: Dish photos in recipe modal, lighter images
versions.changes: Recipe modals use the new dishes photos (cards unchanged). Ingredient photos shrunk to 400px WebP and load at low priority; the modal hero loads first.
